_note: Batch 5. Fourteen candidates read, nine cards kept. Cut on the read: 3081 'Does ER Have X-Ray Services for All Conditions' and 'What Can ER X-Rays Detect' both answer the same question as 'When to Choose the ER for an X-Ray', so one card carries that decision instead of three. 3977 'How ER of Irving Diagnoses' was dropped because its imaging step restates the 'Why X-Rays Sometimes Miss' card. 3091 'What to Expect During IV Hydration' was dropped because it repeats the 30-to-60-minute figure and one of its three items is a comparison against other providers. 3097 'How Is It Diagnosed' was dropped as clinical process on a low-acuity condition, not a decision the reader makes.

cards.heading: What Are the Symptoms of Slipping Rib Syndrome?
title: Signs of
Slipping Rib
Syndrome
cards.alt: Five symptoms of slipping rib syndrome: sharp lower chest pain, a clicking or popping sensation, a lingering dull ache, pain radiating to the back, and tenderness over the rib

items.label: Sharp pain, lower chest
items.note: Or the side, or upper abdomen

items.label: Pain into back or shoulder
items.note: Easy to mistake for back pain
